title: Privacy Policy
description: How The Gypsi handles your personal information.
body:
The Gypsi ("we", "us") respects your privacy. This policy explains what we collect, why, and your choices.

## Information we collect
When you place an order, our checkout provider **Snipcart** and our payment processor collect the details needed to fulfil and pay for your order (name, shipping/billing address, email, and payment information — payment data is handled by the processor, not stored by us). When you join our newsletter, we collect your email address via **Netlify Forms**. [TODO: list any analytics or other tools you add.]

To process and ship orders, respond to enquiries, send the emails you opt into, and improve the store. [TODO: confirm.]
